title: Plot Bhai: a client-side wizard for XRD, UV-Vis, FTIR, particle size and thermal analysis
description: Free, in-browser tools that guide researchers step by step through XRD, UV-Vis, FTIR, particle size (SEM/TEM) and thermal (TGA/DSC) analysis, with publication-ready figures, tables and methods text. All processing runs in the browser. Live site: https://plot-bhai.web.app
